name: ntpnet
description: NTP over the Uthernet II, on the host's real network (NOT in the gate: real DHCP, DNS and NTP servers, real-time pacing, several minutes).  The release /etc/rc is staged back so /etc/netstart takes a lease and sets INET, and /etc/rc then starts ntpd; a test syslog.conf sends ntpd's facility (local3) to the console.  Three things are asserted, each by a needle only output can print: ntp(8) gets a reply from time.apple.com over a connected UDP socket (`delay:', its report line); ifcprobe's SIOCGIFCONF lists the card with an AF_INET address alongside lo0 (the ioctls' card path); and ntpd selects a peer (`clock: select peer').
